plugins.name: Usage Ledger
plugins.description: Records every model request with its client API key, session, upstream account and token counts to a persistent JSONL ledger, and adds a Usage Ledger page to the management UI that shows who spent the tokens on each model over any time window. Raw keys are never stored; name them with key_labels. Made to work alongside Safeguard Killer (https://github.com/esauvisky/CLIProxyAPI-Safeguard-Killer-Plugin).
plugins.author: esauvisky
